name: LiveDot
summary: An 8px green dot with a 2px pulsing ring. Warp signature primitive that signals 'this is live'.

color.description: CSS color value. Override with status.warning.fg or status.danger.fg for non-healthy live states.

label.description: Optional uppercase label rendered to the right of the dot.

rules: Ring is decorative (aria-hidden). Meaning lives in the label.
Animation honors prefers-reduced-motion: ring stops pulsing, dot remains.
Pulse cadence is 3s — slow enough to never trigger flash thresholds.
When state changes in real time, wrap in aria-live='polite' so the label updates announce.

do: Default green = healthy/live. Use warning.fg for degraded; danger.fg for offline.
Place inside Badge[status='accent'] for the strongest 'live' signal.
dont: Don't use multiple LiveDots in the same eye-line.
Don't substitute for a static status — use Badge[leadingDot] instead.

changelog.note: Initial release. Warp signature primitive — 3s pulse cadence locked.
